name: PDF4me
desc: Convert, merge, split, compress, and protect PDF documents.

actions.name: convert_to_pdf
actions.description: Converts a Word, Excel, PowerPoint, or image file to PDF format.

actions.name: merge_pdfs
actions.description: Combines two or more PDF files into a single PDF document.

actions.name: split_pdf
actions.description: Splits a PDF file into multiple documents using one of four split strategies.

actions.name: compress_pdf
actions.description: Reduces the file size of a PDF document while maintaining readability.

actions.name: protect_pdf
actions.description: Adds password protection to a PDF file so only authorised users can open it.

actions.name: pdf_to_word
actions.description: Converts a PDF file to an editable Microsoft Word (DOCX) document.

actions.name: pdf_to_image
actions.description: Converts one or more pages of a PDF file to an image.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
